title: potentilla norvegica var. hirsuta
intro: Potentilla norvegica var. hirsuta, commonly known as hairy cinquefoil, is a plant species in the rose family that is native to Europe. The plant is used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving digestion, and boosting the immune system due to its high antioxidant content. The therapeutic actions of hairy cinquefoil include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiviral agent, making it useful for treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of hairy cinquefoil include flavonoids, tannins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
